goal: Iteratively improve and evaluate the UC-HLMEM naia-memory integration benchmark, preserve reproducible evidence, and publish a benchmark report.
scope: UC-HLMEM deterministic and live benchmark reproducibility
Benchmark quality or measured memory performance improvements
Korean experiment report and stepwise commits
success_criteria: Existing required checks and deterministic baseline are recorded
Each experiment records configuration, raw-enough evidence, metrics, and interpretation
At least one justified benchmark or performance improvement is evaluated against a comparable baseline
Relevant tests pass and work is committed in reviewable stages
A Korean benchmark report states limitations and next experiments
